_comment: Soldier glyph picking and attack targeting (#1570, #1569): a player Spearmen regiment at (600, 500) faces east toward an enemy Infantry regiment at (730, 500) facing west. The player first left-clicks a front soldier marker on their own regiment at (658.5, 500.0) -- 58.5 WU outside the 15 WU center radius -- selecting the regiment. The player then right-clicks a flank soldier marker on the enemy formation at (694.0, 554.0) -- 64.9 WU outside the enemy center. Before the fix, SelectionManager._unit_at tested only distance to unit.global_position within 15 WU, so clicking a soldier glyph returned null; selection failed to register and right-clicking issued a MOVE order to ground coordinates instead of an ATTACK order against the enemy. With the fix, the soldier glyph hitboxes resolve the click: the regiment is selected, an ATTACK order locks onto enemy uid 1, and the spearmen advance and engage the enemy in combat.
